newsitem.title: SPAIN: BBV denies violated stock market rules.
newsitem.headline: BBV denies violated stock market rules.

text.p: Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya reiterated on Friday that it had not violated any rules following allegations by the Stock Market Commission CNMV that it did not respect the rules on chinese walls during a recent takeover.
The CNMV proposed fining BBV 85 million pesetas, alleging that the bank profited from information during Endesa's takeover of regional utility Sevillana de Electricidad.

"BBV regrets that the commission has not taken into account its arguments and reiterates its conviction that it acted at every moment with vigilence, while respecting any decision by the commission," the bank said in a statement.
As is usual practice at the bank, BBV said it was in the advanced stages of revising it codes of conduct and internal rules.
The government must approve the CNMV's proposals before they are effective.
